title: SEC3: Clarify receipt branch structure in outbox_tick
description: In kith-peer/src/lib.rs lines 934-974, the receipt branch in outbox_tick uses nested if-let guards for error handling. The structure differs subtly from the message branch (lines 997-1012) which uses more sequential error propagation. Harmonizing these patterns improves reader intuition about control flow. No functional issue, but style consistency matters.
